research.title: Classification Baselines for Tabular Data with Missing Covariates
bullets: Prepared tabular datasets by checking feature types, documenting missingness patterns, and fitting imputation procedures exclusively on training partitions.
Implemented logistic regression and random forest baselines under specified evaluation protocols, comparing discrimination and calibration across prescribed missingness conditions.

research.title: Regression Baselines under Covariate Distribution Shift
bullets: Prepared regression datasets with predefined source and target partitions, checking duplicate records and applying training-derived feature scaling.
Implemented ridge regression and nearest-neighbor baselines in scikit-learn, summarizing prediction errors across target partitions and documenting evaluation assumptions.

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Maintained inventory records, checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, and flagged discrepancies for review by the operations supervisor.
Organized order paperwork, tracked outstanding fulfillment requests, and coordinated routine status updates between stockroom staff and customer service.

projects.title: Baseline Comparison of Covariance Estimators for Classification
bullets: Implemented linear and quadratic discriminant analysis baselines using scikit-learn, with stratified data splits and training-only feature standardization.
Compared empirical and shrinkage covariance estimates within linear discriminant analysis, recording classification errors and inspecting sensitivity to correlated features.
